metadata.name: parabull
metadata.description: Parabull bonding-curve launchpad: blind launches, ticker registry, 1% fee flywheel, Raydium CPMM graduation

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Nominee: accept the admin role.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy `amount` tokens for at most `max_sol_cost` lamports (fee inclusive).
Partially fills to the curve's remaining tokens; the final fill completes it.

instructions.name: buyback_and_burn
docs: Crank: swap the staged SOL for $PARABULL on Raydium CPMM (enforcing
`min_amount_out`) and burn everything received.

accounts.name: crank
docs: Funds the temporary token accounts; refunded when they close.

instructions.name: claim_holder_reward
docs: Anyone: pay leaf `index` of `epoch` to its claimant (push or pull).

accounts.name: claimant
docs: Recipient named in the Merkle leaf (system-owned wallet). Not a signer:
anyone may submit the claim, funds can only go here.

instructions.name: collect_lp_fees
docs: Crank: harvest post-graduation LP fees via the fee-key NFT and route the
SOL (escrow first, then buyback / holder vaults / treasury).

accounts.name: crank
docs: Pays the temporary WSOL account's rent; refunded in the same instruction.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable: burning the collected tokens reduces the mint's supply.

accounts.name: fee_vault_token_account
docs: Receives the launched-token side; burned and closed before the instruction ends.

accounts.name: fee_vault_wsol_account
docs: Temporary WSOL receiver; closed (unwrapped) before the instruction ends.

instructions.name: create
docs: Blind launch. Signed by the launch authority and the fresh mint keypair;
consumes the ticket, claims the ticker/name locks, creates the curve.

accounts.name: launch_authority
docs: Backend signer; fronts the rent and is repaid exactly that from the ticket.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: Closed to the treasury at the end of the instruction: after the launch
authority's rent is repaid, the fee and anything unspent go there.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Ticket owner; recorded as the curve's creator.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Fresh server-generated keypair; must sign. Holds no authority after this ix.

accounts.name: ticker_registry
docs: Created on first use; re-claimed only after its 3-day lock lapses.

accounts.name: tweet_registry
docs: Required exactly when the ticket carries an announcement tweet.

instructions.name: expire_reward_epoch
docs: Crank or admin: after an epoch's claim window, stop its claims and
release its unclaimed reservation back to the holder vault.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The crank authority or the admin.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time `Global` setup. Only the program's upgrade authority may call it,
so deployment cannot be front-run.

accounts.name: buyback_vault
docs: Destination of swept buyback fees (SOL held as lamports above rent).

accounts.name: holder_vault
docs: Destination of swept holder-reward fees.

instructions.name: lock_migrated_lp
docs: Graduation 3/3 (crank + fresh NFT mint keypair): lock all LP in Burn & Earn.

accounts.name: migration_authority
docs: LP owner and rent payer for the lock accounts (from the reserve).

accounts.name: fee_nft_mint
docs: Fresh keypair generated by the crank; the lock program initialises it.

instructions.name: migrate_raydium
docs: Graduation 2/3 (crank): create the Raydium CPMM pool.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable: unsolicited surplus tokens are burned.

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: keypair that signs this transaction (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: canonical_pool_state
docs: Read only to tell whether someone already created it.

instructions.name: prepare_buyback
docs: Crank: stage `amount` lamports from BuybackVault for `buyback_and_burn`
(send both in one transaction).

instructions.name: prepare_migration
docs: Graduation 1/3 (crank): move the curve's tokens + SOL to the migration authority.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable: unsolicited surplus tokens are burned.

accounts.name: authority_token_account
docs: Becomes CPMM's `creator_token_*` for the launched mint.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin: nominate a new admin (`Pubkey::default()` cancels).

instructions.name: publish_reward_epoch
docs: Crank: commit `total_lamports` of the holder vault to a snapshot Merkle root.

instructions.name: refund_ticket
docs: Return an unused ticket's deposit + rent to its payer. Payer: after
expiry. Launch authority: any time (backend rejection).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The payer (after expiry) or the launch authority (any time).

instructions.name: release_dex_escrow
docs: Pay a funded escrow (`dex_target_lamports`) to the treasury, once.

instructions.name: request_launch
docs: User deposits `Global.ticket_deposit_lamports` and commits to the exact
name/symbol/URI. `symbol` must be the canonical ticker.
`tweet_id` (optional) is the numeric status ID of the announcement tweet.

accounts.name: ticker_registry
docs: may not exist yet (never launched), so it's derived and read in the
handler: a ticket can't be bought for a ticker still in its lock.

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell `amount` tokens for at least `min_sol_output` lamports (net of fee).

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Admin: emergency pause (launches, trading, buybacks, new reward epochs).

instructions.name: sweep_fees
docs: Move buyback / holder / treasury buckets to their vaults (never the escrow).

instructions.name: top_up_dex_escrow
docs: Anyone can add protocol fees to a curve's DexScreener escrow, up to the target.

instructions.name: update_global_params
docs: Admin: partial `Global` update, validated as a whole.

types.name: BondingCurve
docs: Per-token curve. PDA: `["bonding-curve", mint]`.
Lamport invariant: `lamports >= rent_exempt_min + real_sol_reserves + accrued_fees()`.
Fees are tallied here (not pushed to shared vaults) so trades on different
tokens never write-lock a common account.

fields.name: complete
docs: Real token reserves hit zero; trading stops, awaiting migration.

fields.name: migrated
docs: Liquidity seeded into Raydium CPMM and LP locked.

fields.name: escrow_released
docs: DexScreener escrow paid out; later fees skip Stage 1.

fields.name: creator
docs: Wallet that paid the launch ticket. Earns 0% of trading fees.

fields.name: trading_open_slot
docs: No buy/sell before this slot.

fields.name: escrow_accrued
docs: Fee buckets (lamports held in this account until swept).

fields.name: migration_stage
docs: `MigrationStage` as u8.

fields.name: migration_sol
docs: Amounts moved to the migration authority by `prepare_migration`.

fields.name: raydium_pool
docs: Raydium CPMM pool created by `migrate_raydium`.

fields.name: fee_nft_mint
docs: Burn & Earn fee-key NFT mint created by `lock_migrated_lp`.

fields.name: lp_fees_sol_collected
docs: Lifetime post-graduation LP fees: SOL collected and launched tokens
collected-and-burned (measured amounts).

types.name: BuybackVault
docs: Program-owned SOL for $PARABULL buyback & burn. PDA: `["buyback-vault"]`.
SOL is held as this account's lamports above rent.

fields.name: reclaimed_lamports
docs: Unclaimed lamports released back to the vault's available balance.

types.name: Global
docs: Singleton config. PDA: `["global"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Config + emergency authority.

fields.name: launch_authority
docs: Backend signer that must co-sign every `create` (blind launch).

fields.name: crank_authority
docs: Backend signer for migrate / escrow release / buyback / holder epochs.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives launch fees, released DexScreener escrow and treasury fees.

fields.name: parabull_mint
docs: Native $PARABULL mint (buyback target, holder-reward eligibility).

fields.name: launch_fee_lamports
docs: Protocol launch fee carved out of each ticket (0.2 SOL).

fields.name: ticket_deposit_lamports
docs: Total a user deposits into a `LaunchTicket` (~0.23 SOL).

fields.name: ticket_ttl_seconds
docs: After this many seconds an unconsumed ticket is refundable.

fields.name: platform_fee_bps
docs: Platform trading fee, hard-capped at `MAX_PLATFORM_FEE_BPS` (1%).

fields.name: buyback_bps
docs: Post-escrow split of the platform fee; remainder goes to treasury.

fields.name: dex_target_lamports
docs: DexScreener listing target in lamports (admin-updated from SOL/USD).

fields.name: trading_open_delay_slots
docs: Slots between creation and the first allowed trade (anti block-zero).

fields.name: registry_lock_seconds
docs: Ticker/name lock window (3 days).

fields.name: cpmm_program
docs: Raydium CPMM program (mainnet `CPMMoo8L…`), configurable per cluster.

fields.name: cpmm_amm_config
docs: CPMM `AmmConfig` (fee tier) new pools are created under.

fields.name: lp_lock_program
docs: Raydium Burn & Earn LP-lock program and its authority.

fields.name: migration_reserve_lamports
docs: SOL held back from the pool to pay Raydium fees and rent.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer: set by `propose_admin`, cleared by `accept_admin`.

fields.name: parabull_pool
docs: Raydium CPMM WSOL/$PARABULL pool used by `buyback_and_burn`
(`Pubkey::default()` until the pool exists).

fields.name: reward_claim_window_seconds
docs: Claim window copied into each reward epoch at publish time.

types.name: GlobalParams
docs: Admin-settable parameters, validated as a unit.

fields.name: parabull_pool
docs: May be default at initialize; required only by `buyback_and_burn`.

types.name: GlobalUpdate
docs: Partial update for `update_global_params`: `None` leaves a field unchanged.
The merged result is validated with the same rules as `initialize`.

types.name: GraduationReady
docs: The last real token was bought; the curve is locked until Raydium migration.

types.name: HolderRewardVault
docs: Program-owned SOL for $PARABULL holder rewards. PDA: `["holder-vault"]`.

fields.name: total_committed_lamports
docs: Lamports committed to published epochs (claimable or claimed).

fields.name: next_epoch
docs: Next epoch index to publish.

fields.name: total_expired_lamports
docs: Unclaimed lamports released by `expire_reward_epoch`.

types.name: LaunchTicket
docs: User-funded launch request. PDA: `["ticket", payer, nonce_le]`.
The payer commits to the exact metadata; the backend can only consume the
ticket with matching metadata, or the payer refunds after `expires_at`.

fields.name: deposit_lamports
docs: Everything the user paid: the flat deposit, *including* this ticket's
own rent (the ticket holds exactly this many lamports).

fields.name: launch_fee_lamports
docs: Protocol fee quoted at request time. The rest of the deposit repays
the rent the launch authority fronts in `create`; anything unspent
goes to the treasury.

fields.name: metadata_hash
docs: `metadata_commitment(name, symbol, uri)`.

fields.name: tweet_id_hash
docs: `launch::tweet_id_hash(tweet_id)` of the announcement tweet, if any.
Computed on-chain from the numeric status ID so URL variants of one
tweet can't dodge the lock.

fields.name: sol_collected
docs: Measured SOL actually received (unwrapped from WSOL).

fields.name: tokens_burned
docs: Measured launched-token amount received, burned in the same instruction.

fields.name: surplus_tokens_burned
docs: Unsolicited tokens found in the migration authority's account, burned.

fields.name: surplus_wsol
docs: Unsolicited WSOL in the migration authority's account; follows the
unspent reserve to the treasury in `lock_migrated_lp`.

fields.name: surplus_tokens_burned
docs: Unsolicited tokens found in the curve's token account, burned.

types.name: NameRegistry
docs: Name lock. PDA: `["name", sha256(normalized_name)]`.

types.name: RewardEpoch
docs: One holder-reward distribution: an off-chain snapshot of $PARABULL holders
committed as a Merkle root over `(index, claimant, amount)` leaves.
PDA: `["reward-epoch", epoch_le]`. Sized per epoch for its claimed-bitmap.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: `published_at + Global.reward_claim_window_seconds` at publish time.

fields.name: expired
docs: Set by `expire_reward_epoch`; no claims afterwards.

fields.name: claimed_bitmap
docs: Bit `i` set once leaf `i` has been paid.

types.name: TickerRegistry
docs: Ticker lock. PDA: `["registry", normalized_ticker]`.

fields.name: rent_reimbursed
docs: Rent the launch authority fronted for this create, repaid from the ticket.

fields.name: treasury_received
docs: Launch fee plus any unspent operational allocation.

fields.name: tweet_id_hash
docs: Announcement tweet locked for this launch, if any.

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Buy: lamports added to reserves. Sell: lamports removed from reserves.

types.name: TweetRegistry
docs: Announcement-tweet lock. PDA: `["tweet", tweet_id_hash]`.
